title: SG-UMP: Sequence-Guided Universal Multimodal Prioritization Calculation Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.28503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal sequential recommendation (MSR) improves recommendation by incorporating heterogeneous information such as text, images, and user interactions. However, existing MSR methods often fail to capture user-level preference heterogeneity and dataset-level modality bias, limiting their adaptability across users and datasets. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{S}equence-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{U}niversal \textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{P}rioritization Calculation Framework (\textbf{SG-UMP}), a plug-and-play plugin for enhancing multimodal information processing in MSR. SG-UMP includes a Module Combiner for flexible multimodal processing and a Module Router for dynamic module ordering, enabling adaptation to both user preferences and dataset characteristics. translated_title: SG-UMP：序列引导的通用多模态优先级计算框架
translated_abstract: 多模态序列推荐（MSR）通过融合文本、图像和用户交互等异构信息来提升推荐效果。然而，现有的MSR方法往往无法捕捉用户层面的偏好异质性和数据集层面的模态偏差，限制了其在不同用户和数据集之间的适应能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了序列引导的通用多模态优先级计算框架（SG-UMP），这是一个即插即用的插件，用于增强MSR中的多模态信息处理。SG-UMP包含一个用于灵活多模态处理的模块组合器和一个用于动态模块排序的模块路由器，使其能够同时适应用户偏好和数据集特征。在四个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SG-UMP在不同的骨干网络和多模态设置下都能持续提升推荐性能。
tldr: 提出了SG-UMP这一即插即用的序列引导框架，通过模块组合器和模块路由器动态适应用户偏好异质性与数据集模态偏差，从而在不同骨干网络和多模态设置下持续提升多模态序列推荐性能。
en_tdlr: SG-UMP is a plug-and-play sequence-guided framework that dynamically adapts to user-level preference heterogeneity and dataset-level modality bias via a Module Combiner and Module Router, consistently improving multimodal sequential recommendation across diverse backbones and settings.
